title: My flashlight lit something taller than the hallway 🔦
style_prompt: cinematic horror film still, dark moody blue-teal grade, one bright light source, well exposed, 35mm film grain, realistic, no text, no watermark, no faces
hook_text: At 3:33 a.m. my flashlight lit something taller than the hallway.

scenes.narration: At 3:33 a.m. my flashlight lit something taller than the hallway.

shots.prompt: long dark hallway with a narrow flashlight beam on the floor, no person

scenes.narration: The power went out. I woke up to total black. I found my phone and turned on the light. I walked into the hallway.

shots.prompt: dark hallway seen from a doorway, a small cold beam of light on the floor, no person

scenes.narration: The beam showed the floor first. Then the wall. Then a long stretch of ceiling that seemed higher than it should be.

shots.prompt: flashlight beam sweeping up a tall dark hallway wall, no person

scenes.narration: Something stood at the far end. Tall. Narrow. Too tall for the door frame. It did not move. It was leaning very slightly to listen.

shots.prompt: tall dark silhouette at the end of a hallway in thin light, no face, fully clothed

scenes.narration: I held the light steady. The shape did not grow. It simply came closer without walking. Every time I blinked.

shots.prompt: hallway with a tall dark silhouette closer in thin cold light, no face

scenes.narration: I whispered, Dad? The shape bent. Slowly. As if it was copying my voice instead of answering.

shots.prompt: hallway with a tall silhouette bending at the neck in cold light, no face

scenes.narration: My phone was at ten percent. The beam flickered. The shape was close enough that I could feel the air move.

shots.prompt: phone flashlight beam flickering on a wall, tall shadow, no person

scenes.narration: Then it breathed out. One long breath. The flashlight went dark, like someone had blown out a candle.

shots.prompt: completely dark hallway with a faint ember glow, no person

scenes.narration: So tell me. In total black, do you run for the stairs, or stay perfectly still?

shots.prompt: long dark hallway with a narrow flashlight beam on the floor, no person
